crossRefs.note: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will…
You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,
Whose confidence will break apart, Whose trust is a spider’s web.
But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”
His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God’? But you are man, and not God, in the hand of him who wounds you.
I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.” ’

translations.web: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
translations.bsb: When the wicked man dies, his hope perishes, and the hope of his strength vanishes.
translations.kjv: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
translations.asv: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish; And the hope of iniquity perisheth.
